description: This file defines a Flutter widget called StickyCtaBar, which is a bottom-aligned call-to-action bar with buttons for 'See full solution' and 'Next step'. It is designed to stay pinned to the bottom of the app interface, incorporating theme styling and safe area insets.

classes.name: StickyCtaBar
classes.description: A StatelessWidget that renders a pinned bottom call-to-action bar with two buttons, managing theme-based styling and safe area considerations.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget's UI with styled buttons and safe area padding.
